sources.title: How to Visit Lijiang Old Town: Your Handy Tour Guide - China Highlights
sources.content:
Lijiang Old Town: Complete Content Extraction

Overview & History
Lijiang Old Town, also called Dayan Old Town, was "a former trading town and a stop for traders carrying goods on the historic Tea Horse Road." The site achieved UNESCO World Heritage status in 1997. The architecture blends "various ethnic styles, with Naxi architectural elements being the most prominent."

Essential Information
- Location: Gucheng District, Lijiang, Yunnan
- Visitation: Open all day; specific attractions operate 9am-6pm
- Duration: Half a day recommended
- Best seasons: Spring (late March-May) and autumn (mid-October-November) with temperatures of 15-25°C

Top Attractions

The principal landmarks include:
- Mufu Mansion: Royal residence showcasing "Lijiang's ethnic history and culture"
- Lion Hill: Highest point offering panoramic views
- Sifang Street: The town's central, liveliest area
- Giant Water Wheels: Iconic landmark surrounded by flowers
- Dayan Flower Lane: Artistic, photograph-worthy alley
- The Three Wells: Demonstrating "special well-making method of the Naxi people"

Activities & Experiences

Cultural immersion includes visiting Dongba Culture Museum, observing Naxi Hieroglyphs exhibitions, and attending evening performances like Naxi Ancient Music at Naxi Concert Hall.

Culinary highlights feature "wild mountain ingredients and poultry, with a preference for sour and spicy tastes," including chickpea jelly, Steam Pot Chicken, and Lijiang baba. Local markets include Wuyi Street and Zhongyi Market.

Festivals occur throughout the year: Bangbang (February/March), Sanduo (March), Torch Festival (July/August), and Ghost Festival (August/September).

Visiting Practical Details

Daytime vs. nighttime: Daytime offers peaceful sightseeing; evening (6pm-11pm) provides "splendid and bustling" atmosphere with shows and bars.

Transportation:
- From airport: 40-minute taxi ride
- From railway station: 20-minute taxi or 1-hour direct bus
- Walking distance between attractions: 3-10 minutes

Tips for visitors:
- Wear comfortable shoes for cobblestone paths
- Haggle on commodity prices (ethnic scarves typically 15-25 CNY)
- Bring sunscreen; UV is strong
- Purchase flowers near north gate (5-10 CNY per bunch)

Seasonal Weather
- Summer: Approximately 25°C; rainy season
- Winter: 10-15°C daytime; freezing nights

Comparison Towns
Shuhe Ancient Town and Baisha Ancient Town offer alternatives with "more vibrant and traditional local lifestyle" and "excellent view of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain" respectively.

Accommodation Areas
Multiple zones exist both inside and outside the town for visitor lodging preferences.

sources.title: 15 Things to Do in Lijiang + Itinerary & Day Trip Ideas - Nickkembel Travels
sources.content:
Summary of "15 Things to Do in Lijiang + Itinerary & Day Trip Ideas"

Overview
This travel guide covers a three-day visit to Lijiang, China's most iconic ancient town. The author, Nick, recently spent time there and discovered that much existing online information was outdated or inaccurate.

Accommodation Recommendation
Nick recommends staying within the Ancient Town itself, contrary to many guidebooks that suggest staying outside it. The ancient town offers numerous charming guesthouses with local character.

Key Challenges Identified

The author encountered five major obstacles:

1. Transportation Issues - Difficulty obtaining taxis and using Didi (ride-sharing app)
2. Navigation Problems - Maps struggle with the Ancient Town's maze-like layout
3. Payment Systems - WeChat and AliPay are essential; cash is rarely accepted
4. Tour Booking - Joining organized tours like Jade Dragon Snow Mountain requires planning
5. Departure Logistics - Getting out of Lijiang presented unexpected difficulties

Top Activities

Notable experiences include:

- Wandering through the "maze-like" ancient streets and architecture
- Attending performances in the main square
- Visiting Two Cats Cafe for views and refreshments
- Climbing Wan Gu Lou tower for elevated perspectives
- Exploring Mufu Wood Mansion
- Shopping at Zhongyi Market
- Sampling regional cuisine
- Viewing Black Dragon Pool

Nearby Excursions

The guide details two primary day trips: northern temples and ancient towns (including Yufeng Temple, Baisha, and Shuhe), plus Jade Dragon Snow Mountain with sunrise viewing and Blue Moon Valley exploration.

sources.title: Exploring the Old Town of Lijiang in Yunnan China - Feastography Blog
sources.content:
Complete Text Content: Exploring the Old Town of Lijiang in Yunnan China

Author: James Kaewanan | Date: Jul 1 | Category: China

Opening Section
After hiking Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, visitors often take a rest day exploring the Old Town of Lijiang. The area features "hundreds of street food vendors, clothing shops, souvenir stalls, bars, and music clubs." Despite its ancient appearance, it appeals to younger generations as a "trendy place." The author invites readers through "the stone-paved maze-like streets."

UNESCO World Heritage Site

The Old Town (officially Dayan Old Town) earned UNESCO World Heritage status. It dates to "the 12th century AD" and functioned as a trading hub on the "Old Tea Horse Caravan Trail." The culture blends local Nakhi people traditions with Han Chinese influences. The site spans "7.3 Square Kilometers" with confusing, maze-like alleys.

Author's Note: "I found myself lost in the many alleys of the town a couple of times." Google Maps data isn't reliable in Yunnan.

Hotel Recommendations

Lijiang Muqian Hotel - Luxury option with excellent accommodations and included breakfast, elegantly decorated

Lijiang Lize Graceland Merry Inn - Traditional feeling with modern clean rooms and charming Chinese decorations

Xilu Xiaoxie Inn - Budget-friendly (where author stayed), friendly staff, clean rooms, homey atmosphere "like staying at your Chinese aunty's home"

Exploring the Area

Waterwheels: Iconic landmark at the entrance with "imposing design structure" of buildings behind them.

Sifang (Square) Street: Large open area where roads split, concentrated with bars, cafes, and trendy restaurants. Visitors dress in traditional ethnic clothing for professional photographs.

Street Food: Hundreds of vendors line the streets. The author emphasizes eating "your way through the hundreds of Yunnanese street food stalls."

Tea Shops

Traditional tea shops sell compact disks of Pu-Er tea. High-quality, locally-sourced teas are expensive but authentic - "the real deal" comparable to specialty coffee beans.

Bar Street

Located right of Sifang Square, this cramped alley features:
- A shallow river flowing through the middle dividing both sides
- Pink paper lanterns hung on traditional wooden building roofs
- Lush vegetation decorations
- Wild nightlife atmosphere

Interior Details: "Loud music, check. A stage and poles for dancers, check. Bright colored spotlights, check. Those machines that produces smoke that you see in concerts, check. And a disco ball, check."

Nightlife Experience

When sunset arrives, neon lights illuminate the streets creating "a different vibe." The atmosphere combines "Ancient traditional architecture combined with neon lights." Street food stalls transform the area into "a vibrant street food night market." Author notes: "I'm not much of a nightlife person but I think it's worth checking out."

Black Dragon Pool

Located within walking distance, this attraction offers stunning views of Jade Dragon Snow Mountains in the background. A museum/learning center teaches about Nakhi culture and history.

Details & Practical Information

Location: Gucheng District, Lijiang, Yunnan, China, 674100
Opening Hours: 24 Hours | Mon - Sun

Transportation
- Taxi from anywhere in Lijiang City (price varies by location)
- Train from Lijiang Railway Station
- Public buses No. 4 and No. 104

sources.title: How to Navigate the Lijiang Old Town (Without Getting Lost) - Jake and Dannie
sources.content:
Complete Text Content: How to Navigate the Lijiang Old Town (Without Getting Lost)

Published: November 11, 2018 | Modified: April 15, 2019 | Author: Jake

The Old Town of Lijiang, China has earned a reputation for disorienting visitors. The maze-like streets combined with weak navigation app functionality in China and language barriers make it challenging for foreign tourists. After extensive exploration, Jake shares a foreigner's guide to navigating without getting lost.

Before Your Trip to Lijiang

Set Your Priorities: Research attractions beforehand but be cautious of Yunnan tourism sites that include locations tens or hundreds of miles away.

Make Your Reservations: Reserve accommodations online before arrival. Use booking.com maps to find central locations. Crucially: "make arrangements with your hotel or guesthouse to be picked up at the airport, train, or bus station."

Download the Right Apps:

ExpressVPN: Many websites and services are blocked in China. Download a reliable VPN before arrival.

Baidu Maps: Google Maps shows only about 5% of Old Town streets and limited business listings. Baidu Maps works better but is "only available in Chinese!"

WeChat: Essential for communicating with guesthouse hosts and hotel staff. Features include location sharing and WeChat Pay for transactions. Nearly every vendor accepts WeChat Pay.

Google Translate: Download the Chinese lexicon before arriving to enable offline translation without a VPN.

Navigating the Lijiang Old Town

Square Street: Serve this as your base camp - a town square with souvenir shops, restaurants, and traditional Naxi dancers. Four major roads pass through it.

Getting to Square Street from North Gate: Find the water wheel, go left past wishing bells and wooden paddles, head south through willow-lined streets.

Roads from Square Street:
- Southwest corner leads to Lion Hill/Wangu Tower uphill
- Northwest corner returns to North Gate with rougher terrain and Jade Dragon Snow Mountain views
- Eastern end splits two directions: one southeast toward Mufu Palace and White Horse Dragon Pond Temple; another northwest over a footbridge alongside picturesque river areas

Navigating With Baidu Map: Open Baidu Maps at your hotel and save your location (star icon).

Popular Location Chinese Names:
- The Big Water Wheel - 大水车
- Square Street - 四方路
- Mufu Palace - 木府
- Lion Hill and Wangu Tower - 狮子山万古楼景区
- White Horse Dragon Pond Temple - 白马龙潭寺
- Public Toilet - 公厕
- Gucheng Zhongyi Market - 古城忠义市场
- Black Dragon Pool - 黑龙潭公园
- Main Bus Station - 云旅高快丽江客运站
- Train Station - 丽江站
- Lijiang International Airport - 丽江三义国际机场

The Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: Nearly due north of the Old Town, this tall mountain remains visible over rooftops. Use it like ancient mariners used the North Star for navigation guidance.

Asking for Help: If lost, find young adults most likely to understand English. Look for volunteers at intersections wearing bright colors with assistance signs.

Areas of the Lijiang Old Town

The North Gate: Main tourist entry with the iconic Water Wheel. Locate ATMs accepting international cards, American fast food, coffee shops.

The Center: Square Street hub features Instagram-worthy umbrella-decorated alleys. Many food halls exist but quality is generally poor. Better dining in nearby Shuhe Old Town.

The Southwest: Near the end sits White Horse Dragon Pond Buddhist temple - "a really beautiful and quiet spot that tourists don't usually go to." Features: large koi pond with center statue, beautiful stairways, architecture, hilltop shrine.

The Southeast: Lacks major attractions but features beautiful buildings and empty tourist streets. Quiet area ideal for photography.

The River: East of Square Street, a river flows southeast. Following either river direction offers picturesque exploration with beautifully decorated guesthouses and restaurants.

The Center South: Head south through alleys to find local residences and less touristy shops. Gucheng Zhongyi Market is a huge outdoor marketplace with produce, meats, and dried goods - "off the beaten path" and "well worth a visit for foreigners looking for a more authentic experience."

Lion Hill Park: Favorite site inside the Old Town - highest point, quiet, excellent views. Wangu Tower at summit offers outstanding Jade Dragon Snow Mountain views.

Black Dragon Pool: Major park approximately one kilometer north of Old Town. Great for children with scenic areas and fish feeding. Contains temples, pavilion, stone bridges.

Shuhe Old Town: About 10-minute drive north - smaller, quieter, more enjoyable overall.

Other Tips

No Wheels: Lijiang's non-smooth streets prevent rolling luggage passage. Strollers won't work. Pack belongings in backpacks.

Get a Physical Map: Obtain a paper map from tourist information booths.

Say No: Store owners and restaurant hosts frequently wave visitors inside. Unless decided otherwise, ignore pressure.

Pack Appropriately:
- Comfortable Shoes: Extensive walking on unsmooth cobblestones is inevitable
- Sunblock: Mountain air is thinner; use SPF 50+
- Umbrella: Check weather forecasts
- Cell Phone and Battery Backup: Required for navigation, payments, and attraction research

sources.title: Lijiang Old Town Travel Guide 2026 | Top Attractions & Visitor Tips
sources.content:
Lijiang Old Town Travel Guide 2026 | Top Attractions & Visitor Tips

Lijiang Old Town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its stunning natural beauty and cultural heritage. The town's history, enchanting architecture, and the rich traditions of the Naxi people make it one of China's most visited destinations.

Best Times to Visit: The single best tip for Lijiang is to wake up early - between 6 and 9 AM, the town feels like it belongs to you alone. Spring (late March to May) and autumn (mid-October to November) are the best seasons, offering less rainfall, fewer crowds, and comfortable temperatures ranging from 15-25°C.

Essential Practical Tips:
- Footwear & Safety: Wear comfortable shoes with good grip as the old town has many cobblestone paths and slopes that are slippery when wet.
- Sun & Climate Protection: Take sunscreen and warm clothes since the UV is strong and temperatures vary greatly from day to night.
- Ancient Town Maintenance Fee: Remains mandatory and should be purchased at designated checkpoints near main entrances or accommodation, with tickets required throughout your stay as spot checks occur randomly.

Getting Around & Transportation: Cars cannot drive into Dayan Old Town as cobblestone lanes are strictly pedestrian, with most guesthouses meeting you at nearby gates to help with luggage.

The town is a former trading town and a stop for traders carrying goods on the historic Tea Horse Road. It features stunning architecture blending various ethnic styles, with Naxi architectural elements being the most prominent.

sources.title: How to Visit Lijiang Old Town: Guide for First-Time Visitors (2026)
sources.content:
How to Visit Lijiang Old Town: Guide for First-Time Visitors (2026)

Lijiang Old Town is open all day long. Starting from August 1, 2025, there will be charging points at the entrances of the town for individual tourists, with the fare collected by travel agencies for organized tour groups. Tourists receive a receipt once they pay, which is checked when going to some attractions in Lijiang like Jade Spring Park and Baisha Mural. From the day of payment, all tourists enjoy unlimited entries to the town within 365 days.

Seniors over 60 and minors under 12 or below 1.2m (3.9ft) are free of charge.

Best Times to Visit:
Early morning (6-9 AM) features almost no tourists, soft golden light, and the sound of water trickling through the canals, when the Old Town feels most authentic. As the sun dips in the late afternoon to evening, lanterns glow and music spills into the streets, with nights being for dining, bar-hopping, and wandering under red lantern light.

Getting There:
From Lijiang Sanyi International Airport, it is about 40 minutes' drive to Lijiang Old Town, and you could take a taxi or the direct airport express bus to the south gate or the north gate. From Lijiang Railway Station, taking a taxi is a 20-minute drive.

Exploring the Town:
Exploring Lijiang Old Town can take anywhere from half a day to a full day, depending on your pace. Most travelers find the afternoon into evening the perfect time to start.

What to See:
The architecture of Lijiang Old Town is remarkable for its fusion of various ethnic styles, with Naxi architectural elements being the most prominent. Key attractions include Mu's Palace, Lion Hill, Sifang Street (the heart of the old town), and the Stone Bridge.

sources.title: 丽江古城（世界文化遗产）- 百度百科
sources.content:
丽江古城文本内容提取

基本信息

丽江古城位于云南省丽江市古城区，坐落在丽江坝子中部，海拔2416米。世界文化遗产"丽江古城"包括大研古城（含黑龙潭）、束河古建筑群、白沙古建筑群，总占地面积7.279平方千米。

历史沿革

唐宋时期：丽江古城形成于唐代，其雏形为三赕城。从唐高宗上元（674年）至唐昭宗天复（901年），丽江总管中心治所在三赕城。

元代：丽江古城始建于宋末元初（13世纪后期），木氏先祖将统治中心由白沙古镇迁至狮子山，开始营造房屋城池，称"大叶场"。

明代：明洪武十五年（1382年），木氏获得"木"姓。丽江古城进入第一个辉煌时期，成为丽江府衙署所在地，又称"大研厢"。

清代：雍正元年（1723年），丽江改土归流。古城被称为"大研里"，逐步发展成为商业中心。

民国时期：丽江的工商经济发展走向高潮，各类商号达1200多家。

新中国成立后：1986年被列为第二批国家级历史文化名城。1996年2月3日遭遇7.0级地震，重灾街巷有三分之一民居倒塌，不到两年完成重建。1997年12月被列入世界文化遗产名录。

地理特征

地形地貌：坐落在高原台地上，北依象山、金虹山，西忱猴子山。整体地形呈西北高东南低。

气候：属西南季风气候，干湿季分明。年平均最低气温7.75°C，最高气温19.33°C。年降雨950毫米，年日照时数2530小时。

水文：黑龙潭水系是玉河水系主要来源。玉河在古城区域内分流成西、中、东三条河流，又分散成无数条小渠溪流，纵横交错贯穿古城。

景区布局

古城未受中原建城影响，无规矩的道路网，无森严的城墙。布局以三山为屏、一川相连，形成坐西北朝东南的朝向。以水为核心，呈现特有的水巷空间布局。桥梁密集是古城最大特色，共有354座桥梁。民居融合汉、藏、白、纳西族建筑技艺，常见形式有"三坊一照壁""四合五天井"等。

重要景区

大研古城：面积5.39平方千米，主体景点包括：
- 万古楼：狮子山顶，高32.8米，全木结构
- 木府：元代建造，占地46亩，162间房屋
- 五凤楼：明万历二十九年建造，高20米
- 黑龙潭：古城北端象山之麓，东巴文化研究所所在地
- 文昌宫：清雍正元年建造
- 四方街：古城中心，茶马古道重要枢纽
- 古桥：大石桥、锁翠桥等，均建于明清时期

白沙古镇：面积1.06平方千米，属玉龙纳西族自治县管辖。保存原生态风貌，包含大宝积宫、琉璃殿等建筑，内有"白沙壁画"。

束河古镇：由5598栋建筑组成，面积0.83平方千米。青龙河穿过，建于明朝万历年间的青龙桥横跨其上。包含"大觉宫壁画"。

文化活动

民俗文化：
- 丽江古乐（纳西古乐）：融入道教、儒教、唐宋词曲音乐，被誉为"音乐化石"
- 东巴音乐：东巴宗教祭祀活动中的曲调
- 白沙细乐：纳西语"伯石细里"，有多个乐章
- 东巴仪式：祭天、祭风、祭署等30多种
- 丽江壁画（白沙壁画）：明清时期群体创作，融纳西、藏、白、汉画风
- 茶马文化：贸易流通中不同民族文化融合

民族节日：
- 甲子会：六十年轮回庆祝
- 中元节（三美波祭）：七月十三、十四举行
- 火把节：农历六月二十四、二十五开始，连续3-7天
- 骡马会：农历七月举行，已有200多年历史
- 棒棒会：农历正月十五，竹木农具交易会
- 三月会：农历三月举行，龙王庙会

特色美食

- 鸡豆凉粉：用丽江鸡豆磨面制作，黑色外观
- 丽江粑粑：已有300多年历史，用麦面和雪山泉水制作
- 麻补：米灌肠，用猪大肠灌入米和香料
- 饵块：米蒸熟后舂制而成
- 纳西火锅：铜制火锅，冬季待客佳肴
- 纳西烤肉：五花肉腌制后栗碳文火烤制
- 米线：四方街小吃一条街

旅游信息

古城维护费：2025年8月1日起，游客进古城需缴纳50元维护费，有效期一年。
免征人员：丽江市户籍、不足12周岁、60岁以上、残疾人、现役军人等。
开放时间：全天开放
交通：丽江三义国际机场距古城28千米；有到大理高铁和到昆明城际动车；古城内禁止机动车；公交1元一票制
住宿：民居客栈、青年旅社、星级宾馆
